messages.author: 73e2880fdd3361f9
messages.subject: Remove warning messages
parts:
Is there a way to produce a plot without the warning messages.

This happens when data is removed or the default stat_bin: binwidth is
used, for example.

I would like turn them off, if possible, whether it be by argument or
setting.

Thanks,
Barret

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Remove warning messages
parts:
Hi Barret,

You can hide the warnings about data being removed with na.rm = TRUE.
Otherwise see ?suppressWarnings.

Hadley
